description.value: Bench 1775 is an award-winning winery on a 30-acre waterfront estate along Naramata Road — one of BC's most celebrated cycling routes — with sweeping 180-degree views over Okanagan Lake. The winery produces whites, reds, rosés, and icewines across multiple Okanagan and Similkameen Valley vineyards, and operates the Bench Patio Bistro, described by prominent critic Anthony Gismondi as 'the best patio in the world.' Cyclists riding the Naramata Bench pass directly by this destination winery, which offers tastings, retail wine purchases, and full patio dining.
